# Gherkio — Declarative Integration Testing Platform

## What is Gherkio?
Gherkio is a declarative integration testing platform that lets teams write API integration tests in pure YAML. It compiles to a single Go static binary with zero runtime dependencies. Scenarios describe multi-step HTTP request sequences, extract variables, define rich assertions, and enforce security policies — all in a self-documenting YAML DSL.

## Core Facts
- Language: Go
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/muhfaris/gherkio
- Documentation: https://muhfaris.github.io/gherkio/
- Playground: https://muhfaris.github.io/gherkio/playground/index.html
- Author: Muhammad Faris

## Key Features
- Declarative YAML DSL for API integration testing
- HTTP request execution (POST, GET, PUT, DELETE, PATCH)
- Rich assertion engine (status codes, field types, existence, JWT, schema)
- Request retries with configurable backoff
- Outbound network sandboxing (SSRF prevention)
- Multi-account credential support
- Parallel execution
- Native MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI integration
- cURL-to-YAML conversion
- Interactive browser playground

## Quick Start
```bash
# Install
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/muhfaris/gherkio/main/install.sh | sudo bash

# Scaffold a project
gherkio init

# Run tests
gherkio run example/auth/login.yaml -v
```
